lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: I know this post. Third rotation, southeast wall. They changed the guard pattern since I left.
lines.lens: Two sentries. Standard formation. The one on the left keeps shifting weight — new boots or new posting.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: Hold. State your business at the outpost.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: Direct or careful. The guard's posture says routine, not hostile. But Caelan has no papers.
lines.lens: Right hand resting, not gripping. Conversational stance. She's bored, not threatened.

choices.text: Looking for work. Heard the outpost needs hands.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Travelers. Heading north from the ruins.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: The ruins? Not many come from that direction willingly.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: Fair enough. Keep to the main road and don't touch the armory. Commander's orders.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.text: Heard you need hands at the outpost. We're able.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: Always need hands. Talk to the quartermaster inside, but don't expect much. Pay's thin and the food's worse.

lines.speaker: Caelan
lines.monologue: He said that without thinking. Something in him remembers being hungry.

lines.speaker: Zi
lines.monologue: In and through. Don't stop, don't reminisce. This isn't home anymore.
